name: Question 10
worked_solution:
We multiply each row in the matrix by the column vector using the dot product:

$$
\begin{aligned}[\begin{aligned}2 & -4 & 1 \\ 3 & -2 & 5 \\ 5 & -1 & 8\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}1 \\ -2 \\ 5\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}2\cdot 1+(-4)\cdot (-2)+1\cdot 5 \\ 3\cdot (1)+(-2)\cdot (-2)+5\cdot 5 \\ 5\cdot 1+(-1)\cdot (-2)+8\cdot 5\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}2+8+5 \\ 3+4+25 \\ 5+2+40\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}15 \\ 32 \\ 47\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$
